claim_ceiling: This design specifies a test. It does not show that the test ran or that the hypothesis is supported.
environment: CyberAlchemy Lab local checkout at one fixed revision
limitations: The design measures one finite normalization residue model and does not establish general semantic quality or product value
prerequisites: Residue classes are frozen before the run

product_evaluation_context.evaluation_purpose: Measure one normalization-residue signal relevant to the governed Definition admission realization without treating it as proof of the Product outcome or thesis.

question_or_hypothesis: Applying the reviewed semantic-key map lowers finite probabilistic residue entropy in the fixed unresolved source-term set.
stop_rules: Stop after baseline and intervention classifications complete
Stop if source or class vocabulary changes
